Sandbox_NR_Mode_tooltip: Takeover: the mod replaces the vanilla stat update on the server through the CalculateStats hook. Overlay: the vanilla update runs and the mod writes after it. Choose Overlay when another mod claims the hook.
Sandbox_NR_LogLevel_tooltip: How much Nutrition Revamp prints to the server console.
Sandbox_NR_LegacyMirror_tooltip: On: every minute the server writes the vanilla calorie, protein, carbohydrate and lipid stores from the mod's trailing 24 hours, so mods and vanilla code that read those stores (among them the protein store's bonus, which applies to Strength experience only) keep working. Off: the mod leaves those stores alone.
Sandbox_NR_OnsetSpeed_tooltip: Multiplies how fast the slow deficiencies develop and recover: the nutrients that take more than 90 days to reach a clinical deficiency at zero intake, such as folate, vitamins B12, A and D, iodine and magnesium. 1.0 is real time; 30 makes a slow deficiency thirty times faster. Vitamin C, the other fast vitamins, water, caffeine, alcohol, glycogen and sleep are never scaled.
Sandbox_NR_DeficienciesCanKill_tooltip: On: the most severe states drain health until they are treated or the character dies: starvation with the fat reserves gone, long clinical scurvy, beriberi or pellagra, severe dehydration or low blood sodium, and an iron overdose. Off: they never drain health. Hunger and thirst never reach vanilla's lethal top level either way.
Sandbox_NR_ExcessEffectsOn_tooltip: On: an intake above a nutrient's upper limit raises that nutrient's excess level. Off: every excess level reads zero, while the intake is still tracked.
Sandbox_NR_BalanceBonus_tooltip: On: while every tracked nutrient is in its replete band, endurance regeneration and fatigue recovery run 5 percent faster. A game choice with no evidence claimed. Off: no bonus.
Sandbox_NR_Severity_tooltip: Scales every penalty a deficiency or an excess brings: fatigue, mood, sickness, slower healing, heavier bleeding, faster wound infection, colds, body temperature, bruising and Short Sighted. 1.0 is the default; 0 removes them all except the health drains, which Deficiencies can kill controls; 3 triples them. Short Sighted needs 1.0 or more. The few credits (exercise, vitamin C against colds, the balanced-diet bonus) are never scaled.
Sandbox_NR_VisibilityMode_tooltip: How much of each player's nutrition the interface shows. Symptoms: words and icons for everyone, and the exact figures only to a character with the Nutritionist trait. Bands, the default: the nutrient grades and weight band for everyone as well. Numbers: every figure for everyone.
